title: My Busy Week
text:
I have a busy week. On Monday, I go to school. On Tuesday and Thursday, I have English class. On Wednesday, I play football with my friend.

On Saturday, I visit my grandmother. On Sunday, my family and I go to the park. I like the weekend very much.

questions.text: What does the writer do on Monday?
Who does the writer visit on Saturday?
How does the writer probably feel about the weekend?
Why does the writer probably have a busy week?

vocabulary.definition: the first day of the working week
the two days at the end of the week, Saturday and Sunday
a public green area where people go to relax or play
the mother of your mother or father

paragraph_translations: Eu tenho uma semana cheia. Na segunda-feira, eu vou à escola. Na terça e na quinta, eu tenho aula de inglês. Na quarta, eu jogo futebol com meu amigo.
No sábado, eu visito minha avó. No domingo, minha família e eu vamos ao parque. Eu gosto muito do fim de semana.
